Sasha: FYI dashboards spiking on provisional tokens for route /chat/stream after retries + truncated final chunks. :mag:
Ravi: Any concrete example id?
Sasha: router log: `WARN stream_resume id=xyz-77 trim_bytes=48 retry=1 region=eu-west-1` then runtime: `TOOLCALL_START parent=xyz-77 name=retriever` then ledger: `PROVISIONAL amount=22 trace=tl-99`
Elena: Hmm toolcall after resume... are we double-counting the prefix and the toolcall back-to-back?
Mark: We have a heuristic that trims prefix tokens on reconnect, but if the client re-sends the last chunk it becomes ambiguous. Ledger currently attributes charges by `trace_id` only, not session continuity.
Yuri: Could the router create a new `trace` when it retries? If so joins fail. We need a lightweight continuity token.
Sasha: Proposal: emit `continuity_id` on resume that survives retries and include it in ledger rows as `continuity_hint`.
Ravi: Also add `origin=resume_trunc` tag on ledger rows so console filters can surface likely transient provisionals.
Elena: UX: Console per-customer timeline should show a small orange dot for "resume-truncation suspected" and a tooltip: "Provisionals may be reconciled within 24h."
Mark: Triage plan: 1) quick ES sample query to confirm scope 2) add continuity_id to sampled 1% traffic 3) ledger schema PR for continuity_hint and origin tags 4) console annotation and reconciliation audit event.
Sasha: ES query suggestion: `POST /_search {"size":100, "query": {"bool": {"must": [{"match":{"event":"PROVISIONAL"}}, {"match":{"origin":"stream"}}]}}, "sort":[{"@timestamp":"desc"}]}` (adapt as needed)
Ravi: Acceptance criteria: sampled joins >= 90%, UI banner reduces ops tickets by visible %, and ledger reconciles provisionals -> confirmed with audit event so UI flips.
Elena: Any perf concerns? Adding continuity_id to router -> ledger path might add ~1 field but should be ok. We should gate-in feature flag.
Yuri: I'll draft the ledger migration with a nullable `continuity_hint VARCHAR` and a small index; will review with Kevin.
Sasha: Can someone own the runbook blurb for support? Short note explaining what to tell customers when they see "temporary provisional credits".
Ravi: I'll take runbook.
ops-bot: incident#853 created: "provisional-spike-resume-toolcall" tags=[billing,obs,console] assigned->eng-platform
Sasha: thanks team — I'll open the telemetry PR and add the rollout doc in the ticket.
